description: Open or reuse this formed browser room, navigate its current tab, wait for the declared readiness state, and return a fresh accessibility snapshot with element refs. Supply target_id to act on that exact already-owned page independently of the selected or displayed tab. Omit target_id to use the selected tab. Only an invocation without target_id may create the initial page when no tab is selected. This never creates a replacement after host restart or loss of a selected target/context; use a granted browser.tab_new for an explicitly requested fresh page.

target_id.description: Exact already-owned page returned by browser.tabs or browser.tab_new. This does not select, show, create, or focus that page.
